defect: GenerateAllColumnExpressions qualifies SELECT * columns with table->name instead of the alias under which the table was registered, so aliased tables fail to resolve.
reason: AddBaseTable keys the map by alias and BindColumn looks up by alias, both visible in this new file, and the fix replaces table->name with kv.first in the line this change added.

defect: ListSubSystems pre-sizes the vector with sub_systems.size() empty strings and then push_backs the names, returning empty entries followed by the names.
reason: The cleanup commit changed the declaration to a sized constructor while keeping push_back, and the fix switches to index assignment.

defect: alias.extension == extension.name compares two const char pointers instead of the strings, so aliases are only found when the linker merges identical literals.
reason: Both fields are const char * in extension_helper.hpp, and the fix compares through std::string in exactly the line this change added.

defect: The new interrupted_while_flushing flag records any sink block during flushing, so on resume the cached chunk is re-pushed even when nothing was pending (duplicate rows) or after flushing_idx already advanced (wrong chunk).
reason: The fix replaces this flag with blocked_on_have_more_output plus finalize_result_on_block; the faulty use of the flag is in the same commit's pipeline_executor.cpp.

defect: The new resumable sink-interrupt handling only re-sinks final_chunk after a BLOCKED result, so pending HAVE_MORE_OUTPUT work in intermediate operators or in a flush step is dropped or reprocessed on resume.
reason: Sink blocking and resumable FlushCachingOperatorsPush were introduced here (the commit message admits a failing case), and the fix reworks exactly this resume logic with the blocked_on_have_more_output state.

defect: The new Flush bails out only when collection.count is 0, so when every appended row was deleted again it calls InitializeAppend with zero rows, which pushes a zero-row append and leads to an internal error at commit (issue 1091).
reason: Flush and the undo-pushed append path are new in this rework (the old commit-time append wrote with commit_id and no undo entry), and the fix changes exactly this guard to count <= deleted_rows.

defect: ExecutePull now runs in RunFunctionInTryCatch, which turns exceptions into executor.PushError and returns an empty chunk, and on interrupt it silently returns; Executor::FetchChunk never checks the pushed error, so pull-mode errors and interrupts end as silently truncated results.
reason: Before this change exceptions in ExecutePull propagated to the caller; the fix restores rethrowing (taking the executor error first) and drops the silent interrupt return.

defect: The added EndsWith(file_path, '..') guard makes GetFileName return an empty name for any path ending in two dots, such as dir/file.. or dir/.a.b.c.d.e.., which breaks the temporary-file naming in COPY.
reason: The guard is new in this change, the fix removes it and adds COPY tests on such file names.

defect: MoveTmpFile rebuilds the target name as stem + '.' + extension after stripping '_tmp', which appends a stray dot to files without an extension and does not round-trip dot-files such as .a.b.
reason: This change introduced the stem/extension decomposition in place of the tmp_ prefix, and the fix replaces it with GetFileName and a tmp_ prefix.

defect: Misplaced parentheses nest the (child == 0 && IsLeftOuterJoin) clause inside child == 1, so match tracking is never initialized for the left side of LEFT/FULL IEJoins.
reason: The changed condition is self-contradictory on its face, and the fix only moves the parentheses.

defect: Every column not used as a key or aggregate gets a LAST aggregate unconditionally, also for ordinary recursive CTEs without USING KEY, which changes their planning and semantics.
reason: The loop is added here, and the fix wraps exactly this loop in if (!key_targets.empty()).

defect: The cast-error path reads buffer_handles.front()->requested_size, but StringValueResult::Reset clears buffer_handles after each chunk, so front() on an empty vector is undefined behaviour.
reason: The front() access is new in this change, and the fix caches requested_size in the result at construction instead.

defect: flatten references the input's grandchild data (ListVector::ReferenceEntry) but writes running output offsets and computes lengths against them, so the result's entries point at wrong slices whenever the input lists do not start at 0 in row order.
reason: The fix replaces referencing with ListVector::Append of the source span at its source offset, repairing the approach this change introduced.

defect: The new ListLoopHash slices the child with a mutable cursor selection and advances it in place (and indexes ldata without the input's selection, with ridx 0 when there is no rsel), which hashes nested lists of lists inconsistently.
reason: The fix removes this ListLoopHash body, which cc467b8 introduced, and hashes only the list length because of the nested-list hashing bug.

defect: union_null_cols now gets one entry per file column in InitializeSchema, but ScanInternal indexes it by output column up to result.ColumnCount(), which also counts the filename, file_row_number and hive columns, so it reads out of bounds and segfaults.
reason: The same-day segfault fix removes this push_back and sizes the vector from return_types in the scan state instead.

defect: IsSingleLineStatement classifies skipif and onlyif as single-line statements, although they always precede a statement or query on the next line, so valid test files are rejected.
reason: The classification is added in this change, and the fix moves SKIP_IF and ONLY_IF to the return-false group.

defect: After the sorted entries are memcpy'd back over dataptr, the tie detection still reads row indices through entry_ptrs, which point to the old positions whose contents have been overwritten, so ties are computed against the wrong strings.
reason: The entry_ptrs-based loads are new in this change, and the fix reads the indices sequentially from dataptr instead.

defect: pandas_scan_parallel_init takes TableFilterCollection by value while the parallel-init callback type (and pandas_scan_init in the same diff) uses TableFilterCollection *, so the function does not match the callback signature and the build fails.
reason: The parameter type was changed in this commit, and the fix only adds the missing pointer.

defect: The new ZONE_MAP case calls filter_mask.reset(), which marks every row as filtered out, although the comment says zone-map filters should not be applied during the scan; OR filter pushdown then returns no rows.
reason: The case is added here, and the fix replaces the reset with doing nothing to the mask.

defect: A string literal plus ex.what() is const char * + const char *, which does not compile.
reason: The changed line replaced GetMessage() (a std::string) with what(), and the fix wraps it in string().

defect: With ALLOW_EXPONENT, HandleDecimal keeps digits beyond the scale, but HandleExponent mishandles negative exponents (it shifts the exponent by the excess the wrong way, fails D_ASSERT(exponent >= 0), and skips the truncation), so casts such as '1.23e-1' to DECIMAL give wrong values.
reason: Before this change excess decimals were truncated and negative exponents simply divided; the fix titled 'fixed negative exponent conversions' reworks exactly this new logic.

defect: DECIMAL columns in GetInternalCValue now go through TryCastFromDecimal, so duckdb_value_decimal, which calls GetInternalCValue<hugeint_t>, receives the value divided by 10^scale instead of the raw unscaled value.
reason: duckdb_value_decimal (outside the hunks) relied on the raw fetch that this change replaced, and the fix adds a duckdb_decimal specialization that fetches the raw value.

defect: GetExportOrder now skips every schema entry and only emits schemas that a sequence depends on, so other schemas are never exported and objects that depend on them can never be ordered.
reason: The skip is added in this change, and the same-day fix removes it.

defect: cursor.reset(nullptr) lacks its terminating semicolon (and reset(nullptr) is the wrong overload), so the Python package fails to compile.
reason: The line is added in this change, and the fix is the typo correction to cursor.reset();.

defect: In the column-list branch, generated columns are skipped with continue, so column_index_map gets fewer entries than table columns and the insert maps the values to the wrong columns.
reason: The continue was added in this commit (self-described as broken), and the fix removes it so that every table column gets a map entry.

defect: Any qualified column reference in an ALTER expression now throws an InternalException, where a reference qualified with the altered table's name used to bind.
reason: This change replaced the old table-name check with the FIXME throw, and the same-day fix binds qualified names through BindQualifiedColumnName.

defect: GetJoinSide merges child sides with if (child_side != join_side), so a side-less child such as a constant turns an expression that refers to one side into BOTH (and this version also recursed on the same expression over the operator's children).
reason: The combining condition was added here, and the fix adds child_side != NONE to exactly this line.

defect: The header adds ReadTestEnv(), while the same commit's test_sqllogictest.cpp calls test_config.GetTestEnvMap(), so the test runner does not compile.
reason: The 'fix symbol mismatch' commit renames the accessor to GetTestEnvMap and defines it in test_config.cpp.

defect: The fix replaces REQUIRE_NO_FAIL in the worker threads with HasError checks, because Catch assertions are not thread-safe.
reason: The fix only changes a test case's assertion style, which is a test change, not a repair of product code.

defect: CTENode::ToString prints only the parenthesized CTE query and drops the child (main) query, so the generated SQL is wrong and breaks the ToString round-trip.
reason: The method is new in this file, and the fix makes it print child->ToString().

defect: The fix enlarges the test's direct-I/O write to 4096 bytes and closes the writer before reopening, because Windows direct I/O needs sector-sized writes.
reason: The repaired lines are test code only (a test adapted for Windows), which counts as a test change.

defect: update_min_max treats an all-zero min/max as uninitialized, so an empty-string minimum is overwritten by the next value and zone maps prune rows equal to the empty string (issue 585).
reason: The previous std::string version had the same ambiguity (min->empty() && max->empty()), so this rewrite carried over an existing defect rather than introducing it.

defect: With projection_ids present, the column map is keyed by position in the projection list, but LogicalGet::GetColumnBindings uses the projection id itself as the column index, so bindings map to the wrong columns (and the virtual-column bail-out runs after projection_ids were already moved out).
reason: Both pieces are new in this change, and the fix keys the map by proj_id and moves projection_ids after the bail-out check.

defect: The new D_ASSERT(children.size() != 1) is inverted, so every valid NOT expression fails the assertion in debug builds.
reason: The assertion replaced the BinderException in this change, and the fix flips it to == 1.

defect: BoundCTENode::GetRootIndex returns setop_index, although the node's output columns are those of its child, so callers bind to a table index that does not produce the result.
reason: The method is new in this header, and the fix returns child->GetRootIndex().

defect: The extension declares the template FillFunctionDescriptions but relies on a definition in register_function_list.cpp that is never explicitly instantiated for this translation unit, so linking fails with recent GCC.
reason: The cross-TU template declaration is introduced here, and the fix defines the template locally (by duplicating it) to resolve the gcc problems.

defect: sqlite3_step adds each statement's row count to last_changes, so sqlite3_changes returns a running total instead of the count of the most recent statement.
reason: The accumulation is new in this change, and the fix turns last_changes += into last_changes =.
